headline: ECB Names New Board Members, Tightens Credit Inspections on Banks
summary: The European Central Bank appointed two new executive board members and announced supervisory inspections on bank credit underwriting standards, private credit exposure, and cybersecurity resilience.
why: ECB supervision regulates the stability and capital adequacy of eurozone commercial lenders.

impacts.name: Eurozone Banking Sector
impacts.why: Stricter ECB audits on lending standards and private credit risk could curb credit creation margins.
